verdict.rationale: Postman documents an official MCP server offering (postman-mcp-server) and provides guides for registering an MCP server with the Fabric Gateway and generating custom MCP servers from Postman API collections, confirming a first-party MCP server capability that agents can connect to. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of an agent successfully connecting to Postman's MCP server and more detail on the connection/authentication flow.
